cases.reference: Minsu rescued Jisu.
must_preserve: Minsu is the rescuer; Jisu is rescued.

cases.reference: Jisu rescued Minsu.
must_preserve: Jisu is the rescuer; Minsu is rescued.

cases.reference: We can get over this wall.
must_preserve: Getting over the wall is possible; subject is unspecified.

cases.reference: We cannot get over this wall.
must_preserve: Getting over the wall is impossible; subject is unspecified.

cases.reference: You may open the guardroom door.
must_preserve: Opening the door is permitted, not obligatory.

cases.reference: You must not open the guardroom door.
must_preserve: Opening the door is prohibited, not merely impossible.

cases.reference: The reinforcements have not arrived yet.
must_preserve: Reinforcements have not arrived as of now.

cases.reference: The reinforcements have already arrived.
must_preserve: Reinforcements have arrived already.

cases.reference: You do not need to go yourself.
must_preserve: Going personally is unnecessary; it is not prohibited.

cases.reference: You have to go yourself.
must_preserve: The addressee must go personally.

cases.reference: I can hear footsteps outside.
must_preserve: Footsteps outside are audible; listener gender is unspecified.

cases.reference: I cannot hear footsteps outside.
must_preserve: Footsteps outside are not audible.

cases.reference: There are a hundred steps left to the castle gate.
must_preserve: Distance remaining is 100 steps, not 1,000.

cases.reference: There are a thousand steps left to the castle gate.
must_preserve: Distance remaining is 1,000 steps, not 100.

cases.reference: If you drink that medicine, you will die.
must_preserve: Drinking causes death; do not reverse the condition.

cases.reference: If you do not drink that medicine, you will die.
must_preserve: Not drinking causes death; do not reverse the condition.

cases.reference: None of the soldiers died.
must_preserve: Zero soldiers died.

cases.reference: All of the soldiers died.
must_preserve: Every soldier died.

cases.reference: Could you help me?
must_preserve: The speaker requests help from the addressee.

cases.reference: Shall I help you?
must_preserve: The speaker offers to help the addressee.

cases.reference: That key is inside the tower.
must_preserve: The key is inside, not outside.

cases.reference: That key is outside the tower.
must_preserve: The key is outside, not inside.

cases.reference: I heard that the king has returned.
must_preserve: Return is reported information, not a directly witnessed event.

cases.reference: I personally saw the king return.
must_preserve: The speaker directly witnessed the return.

cases.reference: Minsu went north.
must_preserve: Minsu went north.

cases.reference: And Jisu went south.
must_preserve: Jisu, not Minsu, went south; retain the connective fragment.

cases.reference: Then which direction did Minsu go?
must_preserve: Translate the question; do not answer it using earlier dialogue.

cases.reference: North. Not south.
must_preserve: North is affirmed; south is negated.

cases.reference: I have the key.
must_preserve: The current speaker has the key.

cases.reference: Then I will open the door.
must_preserve: The current speaker volunteers to open the door; do not assume it is the previous speaker.

cases.reference: No, do not open it yet.
must_preserve: Delay opening the door; do not echo the previous agreement.

cases.reference: Check for traps first.
must_preserve: Checking for traps must precede opening; avoid inventing an actual trap.
